profile_text.body:
NTT DATA describes itself as an IT services company that helps clients transform through consulting, industry solutions, business process services, IT modernization and managed services. It says it brings a consultative approach and industry expertise to deliver practical and scalable IT solutions, and that it works from strategic consulting through to leading-edge technologies. Its Business Solutions arm specializes in SAP-centric industry solutions for midmarket and international companies in the lower large enterprise segment.

The company began in 1967 as NTT's data division and was spun off in 1988. It is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and is part of the NTT group. NTT DATA GROUP was the subject of a JPY 2.37 trillion buyout by NTT, and a tender offer at JPY 4,000 a share completed in June 2025 with 81.75% acceptance. Delisting of NTT DATA GROUP from the Tokyo Stock Exchange took effect on 26 September 2025.

No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
